summary: GitHub Actions and Jenkins package matrices for implemented messenger, mail, social, and community backbone crates.
claim_boundary: Static CI matrix definition and local validation only. This slice does not claim that hosted GitHub Actions or Jenkins have run these lanes, that branch protection has been updated live, or that ArgoCD promotion/deployment is wired.

facets.F1_simplicity: One dedicated GitHub Actions workflow and four per-service Jenkins package matrices use existing cargo lanes without introducing new CI tooling.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: The matrix isolates messenger, mail, social, and community package slices and disables matrix fail-fast to surface independent service failures in a single run; live branch-protection and promotion evidence remain pending.
facets.F3_adversarial: Static validation checks every Jenkins package name against the Cargo workspace and verifies Jenkins/GitHub parity markers remain present.
facets.F5_quality: cargo check/test/clippy/fmt across the 23 touched backbone packages, YAML parse, Jenkins package validation, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this evidence run.
facets.F7_security_privacy: CI matrix lanes do not add secrets or deployment credentials; Jenkins keeps the existing kata runtime and cosign-required image policy markers.
facets.F11_observability: Jenkins evidence emission now records the concrete package matrix instead of an umbrella placeholder package.
